name: freeride
description: Unlimited free AI access for PicoClaw via OpenRouter's free models with automatic fallback switching
author: Shaishav Pidadi

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Your OpenRouter API key (get free at openrouter.ai/keys)

install: npx clawhub@latest install free-ride && cd ~/.picoclaw/workspace/skills/free-ride && (command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv pip install -e . || pip install -e .)
